author: d. t. muniz
title: There were 10 Asian students enrolled in Greenlee County schools in 2025-26 school year
text:
There were 10 Asian students enrolled in Greenlee County schools in the 2025-26 school year, a 28.6% decrease from the 14 Asian students in the previous school year, according to the Arizona Department of Education.
Data showed that Greenlee County enrolled 1,861 students at the time. Among them, Asian students made up 0.5% of the student body making them the second least represented ethnicity in the county.
Among the six schools in Greenlee County, Metcalf Elementary School recorded the highest enrollment of Asian students in the 2025-26 school year, with five students making up 0.7% of the school’s total enrollment.
Arizona’s K-12 enrollment is shifting amid a declining school-aged population, projected to drop by 40,000 by 2028, according to the Common Sense Institute.
Some data provided by the Arizona Department of Education may be incomplete due to the Family and Educational Rights and Privacy Act.
| School name | % of Asian Students | Total Enrollment |
|---|---|---|
| Metcalf Elementary School | 0.7% | 720 |
| Fairbanks Middle School | 0.7% | 429 |
| Morenci High School | 0.6% | 345 |
Information in this article was obtained from the Arizona Department of Education. The source data can be found here.
